metrics.name: Goal and success clarity
metrics.definition: Before work, record the intended outcome, beneficiary, problem or uncertainty, and observable success condition. At completion, assess each as clear, partial, or unknown.
metrics.interpretation: Clarity is a leading process signal, not proof of impact.

metrics.name: Decision latency
metrics.definition: Elapsed time from a material question or uncertainty being recorded to a decision and actionable next step.
metrics.interpretation: Distinguish waiting from active effort. Unrecorded timestamps remain unknown.

metrics.name: Delivery flow and effort
metrics.definition: Elapsed time from agreed success conditions to verified completion, with blocked or waiting time and approximate active effort recorded separately.
metrics.interpretation: Never infer human effort from chat, tool, or build durations.

metrics.name: Outcome and quality
metrics.definition: Assess the pre-agreed success condition against linked evidence, including follow-up defects, reversals, or rework during an agreed follow-up window.
metrics.interpretation: Tests and builds establish implementation behavior, not user impact. Unobserved user outcomes remain unknown.

metrics.name: DevEnv process overhead
metrics.definition: Approximate active effort spent on DevEnv-specific workflow, documentation, measurement, and upkeep; record friction or duplicated work.
metrics.interpretation: Overhead is a cost to consider alongside outcomes, not automatically waste.

evaluations.title: Diagnose and fix workspace item movement
evaluations.intendedOutcome: Move an existing diagram item interactively and persist its new position in the diagram document.
evaluations.successCondition: A real user drag starts from a workspace item, produces a workspace drop, and visibly persists the item's coordinates; the behavior is covered by an interaction-level regression test and existing document-operation checks.
evaluations.baseline: Headless Edge 155 real mouse press/move/release reproduced the failure: the CDK workspace-to-workspace drop callback received the moved pointer, but the persisted item position remained (0, 0) and inline position styles cleared. CDK drag-start fires on the threshold-crossing mousemove, so using its coordinates as the initial grab point canceled the traveled distance.

measures.value: The user-visible failure, beneficiary, persistence outcome, and gap in existing test evidence were recorded before investigation.
measures.evidence: User report and this WorkEvaluation record.

measures.value: About 1 hour 23 minutes wall-clock from recorded start to verified completion, including time between sessions and pauses; active effort is unknown.
measures.evidence: Evaluation startedAt and completedAt timestamps.

measures.value: The user-visible movement failure is fixed: a real Edge 155 mouse drag moved the item by (100, 80) screen pixels and updated both persisted document position and rendered coordinates; no browser exceptions occurred. All 41 client suites and 573 tests pass. The changed Diagram Page component has 100% statement, branch, function, and line coverage. The full-project coverage command exits nonzero because unchanged shared workflow-todo.types.ts is only 3.17% covered in this client suite; global metrics are 95.57% statements, 91.82% branches, 95.59% functions, and 95.54% lines. Shared and client builds pass. Longer-term user outcome and rework remain unobserved.
measures.evidence: Headless Edge 155 real mouse interaction against /diagram; full client Jest suite; targeted Jest coverage for diagram-page.component.ts; shared and client Angular builds. Coverage details and scope are recorded in diagram-editor-workflow.md.

evaluations.title: Implement diagram connection interaction
evaluations.intendedOutcome: Create a visible, selectable connection between two distinct workspace items through an explicit source-to-target workflow.
evaluations.successCondition: Selecting a source and activating Connect starts a clear connect mode; selecting another item stores and renders the connection; selecting the source again does not create a self-connection; Cancel and Escape leave the document unchanged and exit connect mode.
evaluations.baseline: The document contract and connectDiagramElements operation support validated connections, including endpoint existence, non-self connections, and no duplicate unordered pairs. The Diagram page has no connection controls, interaction mode, line rendering, or cancellation behavior.

measures.value: The developer beneficiary, missing user-level workflow, persistent outcome, and explicit cancellation/invalid-self-link conditions were recorded before the first connection UI behavior test.
measures.evidence: Diagram Editor workflow contract and this WorkEvaluation record.

measures.value: The initial connection interaction is implemented and its focused page suite passes (23 tests): select source, activate Connect, select a different target, persist a DiagramConnection, prevent self-connection, and cancel using the visible control or Escape from a focused item. A selectable SVG line renders for persisted connections. Preview behavior and remaining edge cases/verification are still open.
measures.evidence: projects/client/src/app/system/diagram/diagram-page.component.spec.ts. The next steps and unverified behavior are recorded in diagram-editor-workflow.md.
